newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico subway construction to cost 5.75 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Mexico subway construction to cost 5.75 bln pesos.

text.p: A new subway line under construction in Mexico City will cost 5.75 billion pesos, the Mexico City government said Tuesday.
"The construction cost for the B line is estimated at 5.75 billion pesos in 1996 pesos," the Mexico City government said.
Empresas ICA and Grupo Mexicano de Desarollo will be among the builders of the B line.

The B line will run 14.7 miles (23.7 km) on a north-south route through the capital. Construction will generate 8,000 direct jobs and 12,000 indirect jobs over five years, the federal government said.
